blocks.text: A clean interface has well-arranged widgets and enough space between them. Text and buttons should be clear and easy to read. Responsive interfaces adjust their layout when the window size changes. This helps the program work well on different screen sizes. Proper alignment improves the overall look of the application. Simple design makes the interface user-friendly.
